task: Evidence-supported US-GAAP revenue cutoff with dated authority applicability
failure_policy: All intended cases remain in system denominators; capability on valid responses is secondary and reports coverage
split_policy: Company, original filing/amendments, underlying event and all variants connected components cannot cross splits; inspected cases remain development
uncertainty: Paired company-cluster differences, per-company counts and descriptive intervals; 5-10 clusters limit inference
superiority_claim: No superiority/noninferiority claim without prospectively defined endpoint and decision rule; a benchmark contribution does not require a model win
provider_preflight: Separate development cases; resolve schema and rate limits before scored calls; exact model and routing IDs frozen, no silent fallback
budget_policy: One cumulative ledger retains all earlier spending and conservative unknown charges; freeze worst-case token/retry/tool cost envelope before calls
authoritative_text_policy: Release authorized sources or pointers only; secondary handbooks are explicitly distinguished from governing authority
activation: Blocked until source, rights, reviewed labels, corpus, splits, exact model, prompts, tools, budget and preregistered analysis are filled and frozen
